_README: Every row GLS-MCP-POISON-201 is generated against.
`rows` carry the span the HEAD produces, which equals main's on every one
of them; main here is 7764e2287347027b23bc2c4fcb7622ad22c3f83b, read out of git, not reconstructed.
`divergent_rows` and `reviewer_counterexamples` are the class where the
one-hop form legitimately reports a DIFFERENT span from main: a manifest
key repeated inside the gap, with a phrase starting right after the inner
key and a second phrase later. Main's greedy second hop must consume a
character, so it skips the nearer phrase and ends at the later one; the
one-hop form ends at the nearest. Both still block. Both spans are pinned
so the change is executed evidence rather than a sentence.
